sections.description:
Boost Conversions by 300% using smart Popups — Trusted by 1,000+ Brands.

📈 Picreel is the best WordPress popup plugin, helping businesses turn website visitors into leads and customers with beautifully designed, behavior-based campaigns.

Whether you’re a startup, online store, or marketer, you can easily launch engaging popup experiences like exit-intent forms, lead magnets, discounts, and surveys — all without writing a single line of code.

But don’t just take our word for it — hear it directly from our customers and see how Picreel delivers real results.

“Picreel has given us a 28% lift in referrals to LivePlan over the same timeframe (since starting with Picreel), compared to the previous year. Before installing Picreel, referrals from PaloAlto.com to LivePlan were flat to slightly down. ” – John Procopio, Director of E-Commerce at Palo Alto Software

Create Popups That Perform

  • 🚪 Smart Triggers based on behavior & engagement
  • 🎯 Advanced Targeting by Device, Location, Behavior, and More
  • 🧪 Built-in A/B Testing & Analytics for data-backed decisions
  • 🔄 700+ Integrations — Shopify, WordPress, Mailchimp, and CRMs

🔥 Get started in minutes — No credit card needed. Forever Free Plan included.

💡 Explore More About Picreel:

  • Advanced Features & Capabilities
  • One Delightfully Simple Price for Everything
  • Step-by-Step Guides to Create & Launch Popups

How to Create High-Converting WordPress Popups | Picreel Tutorial

🚀 How your Business Grows with Picreel

Picreel isn’t just a generic popup tool — it’s your complete growth engine for WordPress. Every feature is built to help you convert more of your existing traffic, from capturing leads and recovering sales to personalizing messages and optimizing performance.

Explore how each capability works together to turn visitors into loyal customers — automatically.

1 . Unlock Growth With Picreel’s WordPress Popups

Unlocking growth isn’t about adding more traffic — it’s about converting the visitors you already have. With Picreel’s WordPress popups, every interaction becomes an opportunity to capture leads, reduce abandonment, and drive more sales. Here’s how Picreel helps you do it:

A. Increase Website Leads With Exit Popup Software

Turn visitors into leads before they leave. With Picreel’s exit-intent technology, you can capture emails, phone numbers, and other valuable details immediately — doubling your lead generation and fueling your marketing campaigns.

  • Ask at the Perfect Moment: Use AI-driven targeting to display forms or offers right before visitors exit.

  • Personalize & Convert More: Show dynamic content, custom offers, and personalized popups that resonate with each visitor.

  • Automate Marketing Follow-Ups: Sync leads instantly with 700+ CRMs and email tools to trigger nurturing campaigns.

  • Target with Precision: Segment audiences by behavior, referral source, or return visits to maximize conversions.

  • Optimize with A/B Testing: Experiment with popup designs, CTAs, and offers to find what delivers the most leads.

B. Promote Special Offers with Popups & Overlays

Turn your discounts and deals into powerful conversion drivers by putting them right where visitors can see them. With Picreel, you can design targeted popups highlighting your best offers at the perfect moment, helping you close more sales and grow your customer base.

  • Boost Sales: Trigger exit-intent or time-based popups to showcase discounts, free shipping, or seasonal campaigns that persuade visitors to stay and buy.

  • Collect Leads & Emails: Capture visitor details through engaging offer-based forms and grow your mailing list for future promotions.

  • Direct Traffic Smartly: Guide visitors to best-selling products or clearance pages, improving conversions and customer experience.

  • Build Trust with Giveaways: Run exclusive freebies or trial-based offers to boost brand awareness and make customers feel valued.

C. Increase Website Conversion Rate With Exit Popups

Stop visitors before they leave and turn lost opportunities into new sales and leads. With Picreel’s smart exit-intent popups, you can instantly deliver the right offer at the perfect moment and boost your conversion rates.
* Reduce Cart Abandonment: Capture customers leaving checkout with discounts, free shipping, or last-minute incentives.

  • Boost Conversions with Personalization: Use dynamic content, tailored messages, and behavior-based targeting to convert more visitors.

  • Promote & Upsell Products: Showcase best-sellers, recommend add-ons, or highlight clearance deals right before visitors exit.

  • Re-target Effectively: Deliver custom offers to return visitors and avoid showing irrelevant or repetitive popups.

  • Optimize with Analytics & A/B Testing: Track performance, identify profitable segments, and refine your exit popups for maximum results.

D. Reduce Cart Abandonment with Exit-Intent Popups

Don’t let full carts turn into lost sales. With Picreel’s exit-intent popups, you can detect when visitors are about to leave and give them a compelling reason to stay — from discounts and free shipping to personalized recommendations.

  • Recover Abandoned Carts: Remind shoppers of items in their cart and encourage checkout with targeted offers.

  • Boost Conversions with Personalization: Show tailored recommendations, upsell products, and use psychological triggers to win customers back.

  • Capture Leads Before Exit: Offer coupons or freebies in exchange for emails or phone numbers, then sync data with your CRM for remarketing.

  • Learn Why Visitors Leave: Use quick exit surveys to gather insights and refine your pricing, products, or checkout process.

  • Optimize with A/B Testing: Test popup designs, placements, and CTAs to find the most effective way to recover sales

“Our KPI using Picreel is to generate new signups and it has certainly helped us achieve this. We’ve also seen that the popup has been beneficial to sales performance as well.” – Matt Stevenson, Marketing Manager at Student Money Saver

2. Trigger WordPress Popups Based on Real Visitor Behavior ⏱️

Your visitors don’t all behave the same, so your popups shouldn’t either. With Picreel’s smart triggers, you can speak to the right person at the right moment without lifting a finger. Here’s all you need to know about overlay timing and triggers for delivering personalized interactions:

  • Exit Intent Trigger – Catch them just before they vanish with a timely offer

  • Inactivity Trigger – Wake up idle visitors and pull them back into action

  • Time Delay Trigger – Wait it out, then drop your message at the perfect moment

  • Page Scroll Trigger – Speak up once they’ve scrolled deep enough to care

  • On-click Trigger – Launch popups from buttons, links, or any user action

  • Page Count Trigger – Show offers after users explore multiple pages

  • Click Count Trigger – React when click-happy visitors hit key thresholds

3. Precisely Target Your Audience for Maximum Impact 🧠

Your WordPress popup plugin shouldn’t treat every visitor the same. With advanced targeting, Picreel helps you show the right message to the right person, boosting relevance, engagement, and conversions. Here’s are some targeting options Picreel offers for maximum precision:
Page Targeting – Show specific messages on specific pages

  • Geo Location – Personalize popups by visitor location

  • OS & Browsers – Match offers to users’ devices and browsers

  • Traffic Source – Customize content based on where users came from

  • Cookie Targeting – Use stored data to tailor repeat visits

  • Engagement Targeting – Trigger popups based on past actions

  • Date & Time – Schedule popups to appear at just the right moment

  • Device-Based Targeting – Serve optimized content on desktop, mobile, or tablet

4. 📊 Use Data to Optimize WordPress Popup for More Conversions

Launching a popup is just the beginning. With built-in analytics and A/B testing, Picreel’s WordPress popup plugin helps you understand what’s working, what’s not, and how to optimize every interaction for higher conversions.
Performance Metrics – Track views, clicks, conversions & form fills in one place

  • Behavior Insights – Analyze user activity to refine messaging and timing

  • Trend Tracking – Monitor long-term campaign performance and growth patterns

  • Conversion Optimization – Identify and scale high-impact tactics with confidence

  • A/B Testing Tools – Test popup variants and personalize design based on results

5. Connect Picreel With 700+ Tools to Automate & Scale🔌

Don’t let leads sit idle. Picreel’s WordPress popup plugin integrations let you connect seamlessly with your favorite CRMs, email platforms, CMSs, ecommerce tools, and more. So, you can automate follow-ups, personalize popups, and scale faster.

  • CRM Integrations – Send leads instantly to Salesforce, HubSpot, Keap, and more

  • Email Marketing Tools – Connect with Mailchimp, AWeber, Constant Contact & others

  • CMS Platforms – Works with WordPress, Joomla, Wix, Drupal, Blogger & more

  • eCommerce Integrations – Boost sales with Shopify, Magento, PrestaShop & BigCommerce

  • Automation & Analytics – Use Zapier, Webhooks, GA, and Tag Manager to streamline everything

“Picreel is an excellent tool to use for capturing leads. If you are in the business of collecting opt-ins so you can market to potentially interested leads, Picreel is a tool worth investing in.” – Raymond Fong, Co-Founder of Deviate Labs, LLC

Requirements

  • WordPress 4.5 or higher
  • PHP 5.6 or higher
  • A Picreel account with your custom script key

sections.installation:
1. Install the Picreel plugin from the WordPress repository.
  2. Log in to your Picreel enterprise account.
  3. Go to “Campaigns” and click “New Campaign” to choose a template or start from scratch.
  4. Customize your popup using the drag-and-drop editor to match your brand.
  5. Set targeting rules like exit intent, scroll depth, or time delay.
  6. Done! Popups will start running on your WordPress site.

For detailed setup instructions, visit Picreel Plugin Help.
sections.faq:
How do I install and activate the Picreel popup plugin on WordPress?

To install Picreel on WordPress, download the plugin from the WordPress repository and create a free Picreel account. Then, design your popup, set targeting rules, and activate the campaign. For full setup steps, check the Picreel Plugin Help.

Will popups affect my website’s loading speed?

No. Picreel popups load asynchronously and are optimized for performance, ensuring they don’t impact your website’s loading time.

Is customer support provided?

Yes, Picreel provides free assistance to users at every step through a dedicated and proactive support team. You can also get instant help 24/7 via our AI-powered chatbot, designed to handle common queries efficiently.

Can I run multiple campaigns simultaneously?

Yes, you can create unlimited campaigns with different targeting rules and display conditions.

Can I use Picreel on multiple websites?

The free plan includes unlimited domains, with additional features and higher pageview limits available on paid plans.

What file formats are supported for custom designs?

You can upload your own image and customize designs using our built-in editor or HTML/CSS modifications.

Can I schedule popups to appear only during specific dates or times?

Yes, you can easily schedule popups to appear during specific dates and times. Just go to your campaign settings, navigate to the “Schedule” option, and set the desired date, time, and choose between one-time or recurring display.

How do I show different popups on different pages or blog posts?

You can show different popups on specific pages or blog posts by using URL-based targeting rules in your campaign settings. Use options like “Contains”, “Equals”, or “Does not equal” to control where a popup appears. For example, entering “blog” under “Contains” will display the popup on any URL that includes /blog/.

Can I integrate Picreel with tools like Mailchimp and HubSpot?

Yes, you can easily integrate Picreel with tools like Mailchimp and HubSpot. Just go to the Integrations section in your Picreel dashboard, select the tool you want to connect, and follow the prompts to add your access token and choose the campaign.
